event_availability: Recovery events require a configured native request and its existing recovery producer; unsupported producers fail generation. Stage names never produce events.
transition_semantics: One transition per FlightTask step; strictly increasing acquisition identity for numeric holds; unavailable, nonfinite, future, stale, changed-source and changed-epoch inputs reset pending holds.
action_semantics: At most one configured recovery stage calls the existing request owner; the existing output and lifecycle permissions remain authoritative. Each request is attempted once, never inferred complete or retried into a second actuation.
identity: Unique nonzero CRC32 of each stable ASCII stage ID, checked before generation; schema and full configuration also retain their exact SHA-256 receipt.
legacy: Schema 1 remains the desktop reference profile. An imported absent profile retains the legacy lifecycle; opening the GUI does not migrate it. A new project explicitly selects schema 2.
default: ready then ascent on accepted START; no implicit coast, deployment or landed stage. Optional acceleration detection uses separate 200 ms holds at 2 g. Optional recovery requires an explicitly selected existing parachute target.
